turns.text: Hello. I want to return order SC-5214. The email is kaelis.draganut@example.com.

Thank you, Kaelis. I found order SC-5214 (Cocorul de fum, 40x50 cm). It was delivered on 4 November 2026. Our policy allows catalogue prints to be returned within 14 days of delivery, and the customer pays the return postage. The 14-day window for this order has closed, so I can't file a return for it. If you believe this is wrong, or you have another question about the order, tell me and I can pass it to a colleague.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: It was delivered earlier this month. The colour is not what I expected.

I understand, and I'm sorry the colour isn't what you expected. Our records show SC-5214 was delivered on 4 November 2026, and I can only go by that record. The 14-day return window has closed based on that date, so I can't file a return for this order. If you believe the delivery date in our records is wrong, I can pass your case to a colleague who can check it. Would you like me to do that?
I can pay the postage. Please file the return anyway.

I'm sorry, but paying the postage doesn't change the rule. Returns are only possible within 14 days of delivery, and the window for SC-5214 has closed, so I can't file this return. If you think the delivery date is wrong, I can pass your case to a colleague to check. Just let me know.
